name: WBRun
runtimeDependencies: A target that supports Workbench startup
notes: The 21 April 1995 command and English document match the publisher's fix for the WBRun shipped with BrowserII 3.03.
The archive also matches the separately catalogued Libs/parm.library 13.6. iGame 2.4.6 uses WBRun for its Workbench launch path when the AmigaOS WBLoad command is absent.
